snippet.title: Bloxd Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Bloxd here: https://bloxd.io

Check out the trailer for Bloxd our massively multiplayer voxel world, where players can come together to take on the risk of fighting zombies in the night, build vast cities in various biomes or explore some of the incredible game modes created by our community from first person shooters to classic hiding games.

Credit to the following for helping this come to life:
Sugar_Apple777 - Created the game "Backrooms"
Flamc04 - Created the game "Parkour Spiral 3"
DraugrrKnight - Created the game "Bloxd Chameleon UPD"
Shaders made by Kbloxdz
@arithemonkey  - Trailer Design
